name: Divine Omen
detailed_description:
Thanks for checking out Divine Omen! Play the first chapter for FREE by visiting this game's demo page.

Avan did his best to ignore the nightmare from the night before. It was something he'd learned to live with - something he'd dealt with since childhood.  It was easy to write it off until his dreams followed him into the morning - a distant yet familiar voice invading his ears while his palm seared from a burn that wasn't really there.

The young man holds his aching hand as he makes his way to the watchtower he'd been summoned to. A little girl was found dead in the woods outside the city early that morning. Her body was covered in black blood, a sign that something sinister lurks outside the city walls. A number of reports on the Guard Captain's desk suggest she's just one of many victims. Against the wishes of the Lord,  Avan is tasked with investigating the scene where the young girl's body was found. The night before he was set to depart, two strange figures visited his dreams. They came with an eerie message:

"Executioner...your first and your final trial waits for you there...at the temple."

It didn't mean anything. At least not then.

In Divine Omen, your choices mean life or death. Use the messages in Avan's dreams to save the lives of the people close to him...or send them to an early grave. Even the most inconsequential actions can have dire outcomes. Listen carefully.

Use Avan's journal to further immerse yourself in the world around you and the characters who call it home. The journal is a tool for refreshing yourself on what you've seen and even catching up on what you may have missed.

  • Story rich, choice driven narrative featuring horror, fantasy, and LGBTQ+ themes

  • Simple point-and-click gameplay suitable for all skill levels

  • Full controller and keyboard support

  • Complex, lively characters that respond to your actions

  • Journal feature provides optional character, event, and environment lore

  • An entirely original soundtrack featuring 8 compositions

  • Over 500 hand drawn sprites, backgrounds, and journal entries

  • 40,000 words and over 4,000 unique lines of dialogue

  • Episodic release - more to look forward to later!

  • Estimated 2.5 hours of gameplay

Divine Omen is an EPISODIC RELEASE. This is Chapter 1 of 5 parts planned so far. As it's the first in the series, it will be free to play. With that said...

You're always welcome to leave a donation on Ko-fi if you enjoyed the game. If you can't donate, that's okay! You can still help by sharing the game with someone you think would enjoy it and asking them to do the same.  You can also find links to my game dev accounts on this page. Every little bit helps.

short_description: Divine Omen is a horror adventure game featuring dark fantasy themes and point-and-click elements. Unravel the mystery behind the girl's murder and find the salvation you crave. Pay close attention and make wise choices...they can mean the difference between life and death for those around you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: WIN 10
  • Processor: 1.8 ghz dual core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 or higher
  • Processor: Intel-based
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated/Dedicated GPU with OpenGL support
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS (based on Linux)
  • Processor: 1 ghz or faster
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.0 or higher, DirectX 9, OpenGL ES2, or WebGL
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
Divine Omen contains themes that aren't suitable for all players. These themes include:
mental illness/suicidal ideation, child abuse, fire/severe burns, gore/death

Reach out to someone you love if you are experiencing negative thoughts.
